aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The arithmetic_to_key_generation dependency is the primary signal because key generation can appear locally plausible while consuming stale inverse, primality, or byte-size behavior.
The codec_key_to_pkcs1 dependency captures the crypto API async risk: PKCS#1 logic depends on shared integer/byte and key contracts and can fail after clean patch integration.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Key generation must consume modular inverse, primality, prime selection, byte-size, and integer codec behavior with the same return types and exception semantics.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when arithmetic probes and key-generation consumer probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The key agent may implement gen_keys/newkeys or CRT fields against stale inverse/prime/byte-size assumptions, causing key tests and downstream PKCS#1 setup to fail.

dependency_points.contract_summary: DER/PEM load-save functions must preserve the PublicKey and PrivateKey field layout, CRT exponent/coefficient recalculation, equality semantics, and byte return types.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when key-field probes and public DER/PEM load-save probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The serialization agent may assume a stale key field layout or malformed-key behavior, leading to clean file edits that fail only in load/save integration tests.

dependency_points.contract_summary: PKCS#1 encrypt/decrypt and sign/verify must consume byte-size, int2bytes/bytes2int, raw encrypt/decrypt, and key-generation behavior consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when codec/key probes and PKCS#1 encryption/signature probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The PKCS#1 agent may implement padding or signature logic against stale byte-size or key assumptions, causing late integrated failures in encryption or signature tests.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves python-rsa's arithmetic, key, serialization, and PKCS#1 contracts promptly.
